title: Porting a ranked objective list to setObjectiveN
heading: gurobipy Solves the Hierarchy Natively, and Its Priorities Run the Other Way
cases: three maximized levels with priorities 0, 1, 2 and every tolerance set come out in the same order of optimization, with weight 1 and the same tolerances
a minimized level in a model whose sense is maximize gets weight -1
a level whose absolute tolerance is None gets abstol 0, not Gurobi's default
levels with priorities 7, 0 and 3, listed in that order, are optimized 0, 3, 7
